name: Monument de la Réunification
description: An iconic spiraling monument commemorating the 1961 reunification of French and British Cameroon. One of the most photographed landmarks in the capital, offering panoramic views of the city from its viewing platform.

name: Hilton Yaoundé
description: A landmark 5-star hotel in the heart of downtown Yaoundé, known for its rooftop pool, panoramic city views, and easy access to government and business districts.

name: Lac Municipal
description: A scenic municipal lake and park popular for weekend strolls, paddle boating, and lakeside dining. A peaceful escape from the bustle of the city center.

name: Le Safoutier
description: A beloved local restaurant serving authentic Cameroonian cuisine in a warm, garden-like setting. A favorite for both locals and visitors craving traditional flavors.

name: Playce Yaoundé
description: A modern shopping and entertainment complex featuring retail stores, a cinema, restaurants, and play areas — a go-to spot for a fun day out with family or friends.

name: Mont Fébé
description: A forested hill overlooking Yaoundé, popular for hiking, golf, and sweeping sunset views over the city's seven hills.

name: Musée National du Cameroun
description: Housed in a former presidential palace, this museum showcases Cameroon's rich cultural heritage through art, artifacts, and royal regalia from across the country's regions.

name: Marché Central
description: A vibrant, bustling central market where you can shop for textiles, crafts, spices, and fresh produce while soaking in the energy of everyday Yaoundé life.

name: Hôtel Mont Fébé
description: A hillside resort hotel on Mont Fébé with sweeping views over Yaoundé, an on-site golf course, and easy access to hiking trails through the surrounding forest.
